# awscc_logs_storage_tier_policy (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Logs::StorageTierPolicy



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) The AWS account ID that owns this storage tier policy.
- `last_updated_time` (Number) Timestamp (milliseconds after Jan 1, 1970 00:00:00 UTC) when the storage tier policy was last updated.
- `storage_tier` (String) The storage tier to apply. Only INTELLIGENT_TIERING is accepted for creation.
